description: The Wait park queue: one row per parked rule-fire segment. It binds to an IMMUTABLE CRM Automation Rule Version, never to the mutable rule - so editing a rule can never re-route, duplicate or orphan a lead already executing it. automation.resume.sweep_resume() resumes run_effects from `cursor` at/after `resume_at`. Runtime data only - never seeded (A.17).

fields.label: Rule
fields.description: Reporting and migration scoping only. The executor reads the frozen version, never this.

fields.label: Rule Version
fields.description: The immutable definition this execution runs. Advanced only by a migration whose prefix check proved it safe.

fields.label: Cursor
fields.description: Index into the frozen version's action list of the next action to run. The Wait this execution sleeps in is the action at cursor - 1.

fields.label: Parked At
fields.description: When the execution entered its Wait. The INPUT from which resume_at is derived - so editing the Wait's delay re-derives the wake time instead of restarting the clock.

fields.label: Resume At
fields.description: A cache of parked_at + the Wait's delay. Refreshed when its inputs change.

fields.label: Status Reason
fields.description: Why this execution ended the way it did. Empty while Pending.

fields.label: Context (JSON)
fields.description: The trigger context, frozen at the original fire. A fact about the past - never refreshed.

name: CRM Automation Resume
